title: Default-on form, dataset and data-module rules
summary: form-object-without-field, foreign-form-control-access and dataset-edit-without-post are on by default; form-object-without-field skips a shipped list of DevExpress sub-object classes plus the project's own exempt classes
intro: Read this when a form object without a field, a control reached through another form's global variable or a dataset left in edit mode now shows up without --enable, or when you need to silence a form object class (a third-party sub-object the designer creates without a field) for your project.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint rules [--json] [--category <name>] [--standard cwe|cert|misra] [--rule <id>[,<id>]] [--rules-dir <dir>] [--target-compiler <ver|auto> [--project <.dproj>]] - list every lint rule (catalog; each labelled rule shows its CWE/CERT/MISRA ids, --json adds `compliance` and needs_compiler / compat_since / target_active; --standard lists only rules labelled under it; --rule <id>[,<id>] lists only those rules, an unknown id is exit 2)
